results.name: Guardians without a kit keep no tiers; a kit guardian turns at two thirds and one third of its health
A credited seed stops at a threshold and the next is guarded; powers and uncredited strikes pass it
The mood change is a 1.3 s guarded warning, then Phase Bloom: the next tier, a beat of rest, faster moves
A guardian dropped past both thresholds at once changes one mood per warning
Kit timers and lob flights keep the guardian clock: a Lullaby holds them
A beaten kit guardian leaves nothing behind: no moon gates, carried flowers, timers or raised line
bosses.js never touches the seed pod and never uses Math.random
